meta.title: Harboursville — Sydney geography
meta.geographyNote: Harboursville is the fictional city name. Redfern is south of the CBD, Milsons Point is on the north shore, and North Ryde is further north along Lane Cove Road. Roads between them are real OpenStreetMap centerlines, not a teleport grid.

verticalScale.bridgeDeck: stylized sine profile peaking at 30 m so the span meets the ground at both mapped ends
verticalScale.bridgeArch: original stylized truss, not a surveyed model and not the real 134 m arch
verticalScale.operaShells: original stylized shells aligned to the OSM footprint
verticalScale.estimatedBuildingHeights: used only where OSM has neither height nor building:levels

meta.imagery: No aerial photography and no photogrammetry in this database. Surface photographs are separate CC0 textures, not Google imagery.
limits: The playable box runs from Redfern in the south to North Ryde in the north, and from Lane Cove Road in the west to the harbour in the east. Local streets and buildings are kept inside four districts. Arterial roads connect the districts. The land between them is not filled with every terrace.

OpenStreetMap building footprints with height or building:levels are kept, tallest first, up to 480 in each district. Untagged footprints are omitted instead of being given invented tower heights. If a district cap is not full, leftovers get a modest deterministic estimate marked heightSource=estimated.
The Opera House shells and Harbour Bridge arch, pylons, and deck profile are original stylized models. Only their plan position comes from OpenStreetMap.
No Google photogrammetry, no Bing/Maxar imagery, and no Microsoft building-footprint dump.
This file is a derived database under the Open Database License.

mission.title: Harboursville run
mission.brief: Drive the gold rings in order: Opera House forecourt, Harbour Bridge crest, Milsons Point, North Ryde, Redfern, then back to Circular Quay. Redfern is south of the CBD. The roads between districts are real.
